brief:
More than 50 British MPs are demanding fresh sanctions against Israel over obstruction of humanitarian aid to Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The call comes as storms hit the territory while 150,000 tents intended for aid distribution remain stuck in lorries outside the Palestinian enclave.

Israel controls entry points into Gaza and has restricted the flow of humanitarian supplies to the besieged population.

title: Fifty British MPs call for Israel sanctions over Gaza aid blockade
